title: probe-events/1
description: One sanitized coding-agent session event: the `raw` of each `{line_no, raw}` in a protocol-2 session batch. All four tap sanitizers emit it (tap_core/sanitize.py for Claude Code, codex_sanitize.py, pi_sanitize.py, kimi_sanitize.py) in Claude Code's user / assistant / system shape. It describes exactly what they emit from tap 0.9.11 on, not what a harness writes: every key is allow-listed and typed, and anything else stays on the researcher's machine. Optional fields are absent, never null, unless their type says null. Out of contract: a transcript line that is not a JSON object. The Claude Code and Codex sanitizers return it unchanged (the legacy batch builder keeps an unparseable line as a raw string on purpose; the protocol-2 journal drops lines that do not parse), and real transcripts have none. Clients from before 0.9.11 send no `inference_id`, `usage` or `origin`, and clients from before 0.9.9 sent more keys than this schema allows; a reader must accept both. Held by agent/tests/test_probe_events_contract.py.

type.description: Codex, pi and Kimi emit `user`, `assistant` or `system`. Claude Code also forwards its own other event types (`attachment`, `queue-operation`, `mode`, ...) reduced to the keys below; the renderer shows only a string `content` for those.

subtype.description: On `system` events. Harness-defined and open: Claude Code's own (`compact_boundary`, `local_command`, `away_summary`, ...); Codex `session_start`, `turn_context`, `compaction`; pi `session_meta`, `compaction`, `branch_summary`, `label`, `model_change`, `thinking_level_change`, `session_info`, `custom:<customType>`, `unknown:<type>`, `unknown:message:<role>`, `unparsed`; Kimi `session_meta`, `compaction`, `shell_output`, `skill_activation`, `clear`, `undo`.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 as the harness wrote it (Kimi's epoch milliseconds converted to UTC). null when the line had none.

content.description: Top-level text of a `system` event (a compaction or branch summary, a local command line) or of a forwarded Claude Code event such as `queue-operation`. Conversation text: uncapped.

isCompactSummary.description: Claude Code: this `user` event is the model's own summary written at a compaction, not something the researcher said.

parentUuid.description: Claude Code: the event before this one; null on the first.

logicalParentUuid.description: Claude Code: on a `compact_boundary`, the event before the compaction.

inference_id.description: The model call this `assistant` event came from: Claude Code's Anthropic message id (every line of one call shares it), pi's entry id (one entry per response), Kimi's `<turn_id>:<step>`. Codex: never set. Absent also on events from clients before 0.9.11.

origin.description: Set when the researcher's own shell command produced the event (pi's `!` bashExecution, both halves; Kimi shell-mode input), so no reader takes it for model output or counts it as an inference. Absent otherwise.

model.description: Claude Code: the model that wrote this turn. pi puts it in `_pi_extras.model`.

stop_reason.description: Claude Code: why the call stopped; null while it is still streaming.

thinking_block.description: Reasoning text. Signatures and encrypted reasoning never ship.

tool_use_block.description: A tool call as a summary and counts. The arguments never ship.

summary.description: The full shell command (capped at 4,000 characters), else the first line (capped at 200) of the first of command / file_path / path / pattern / url / query / description. Absent for a tool whose arguments match none.

edit_stats.description: Shape of a file change: counts, never content.

tool_result_block.description: A tool's result as its size. The output never ships.

is_error.description: Present only on a failed call.

result_bytes.description: Characters of text in the result.

media_block.description: A pasted image (Kimi also audio, video): its media type and encoded size, never the bytes.

media_url_block.description: Media given as a remote link: the link is a pointer, not content.

dropped_block.description: Claude Code: a content block of a type the sanitizer does not name (a document, a server tool's call or result, redacted thinking, ...). Its type only.

unknown_block.description: pi and Kimi: a content part of a type the sanitizer does not name. Its type only.

attachment.description: Claude Code attachment events ship only for allow-listed types, with only their named keys. Every other attachment, including any that holds a file's contents, is not sent.

usage.description: Token counts of the call named by `inference_id`, as reported with this event: Claude Code repeats a growing snapshot on each line of a call, so the last one is the call's total. Counts the harness did not report are absent. Claude Code and pi only.

codex_extras.description: Codex-only facts, by allow-list. Values marked verbatim are copied from Codex's own record unchanged.

git.description: session_meta, verbatim: commit, branch, repository URL.

reasoning_summary.description: response_item.reasoning, verbatim: the model's reasoning summary.

pi_extras.description: pi-only facts. pi is an untrusted producer (forks, SDK embeds): every value is type-checked and capped.

version.description: session_meta: session format version; null when not an integer.

parent_session.description: session_meta: the file a /fork or /clone came from.

data_keys.description: custom: the names an extension stored, never the values.

origin.description: Kimi's own origin kind for a user event that is not a typed prompt.

result_bytes.description: shell_output: size of the output, never the output.
